name: A source
title: One line, *and the rows stay*
lede: Rows in memory are lost at every restart, so we add SQLite with one line in sources. The app then refuses to start until the table exists, and fougere migrate creates it.
fig: The handler asks for its rows as before. Where they live is a line of config.

grows.label: the posts table
grows.detail: created by fougere migrate, read from Post

grows.label: the boot, until you migrate
grows.detail: the database is missing 1 change(s): posts — no table, and the command that adds it

aside: On Postgres it is { type: 'pg', url: process.env.DATABASE_URL }, and nothing else in the project changes.
